title: Retail Credit Risk Manager
description:
Nova oportunidade para Retail Credit Risk Manager em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Revolut   People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 75+ million customers get more from their money every day.   As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.    About the role    Risk at Revolut operates across all functions, products, and regions to monitor front-line performance and ensure the business operates safely. They’re among the first to be involved in new initiatives, from tech to customer support.   We’re looking for a Risk Manager who'll support growing our retail credit portfolio. You'll make data-driven decisions on risk-adjusted return requirements and lead preventive and reactive actions that impact portfolio credit performance and profitability.   Up to shape what's next in finance? Let’s get in touch.    What you'll be doing    Overseeing exposure to retail credit risk   Working with the Risk Modelling team to design, develop, and implement retail credit risk models   Managing risk appetite through limit calibration and monitoring   Maintaining key policies, procedures, and controls   Engaging with first-line businesses to identify, monitor, and govern emerging retail credit risks, including new product risk assessments   Engaging with key stakeholders, committees, and regional regulators on material retail credit risk exposures and limit governance   Quantifying risk exposures within the organisation, taking into consideration stakeholder impact   Protecting the company from excessive risk-taking, saving on both short and long-term costs   Building trust and reputation with our external stakeholders and ensuring risks are managed within the risk appetite   Identifying emerging risks that require immediate attention or could threaten long-term viability     What you'll need    Experience in consumer credit risk within a financial institution, bank, asset management, payment institution, and/or related services firm   Knowledge of key lending products, like credit cards, personal loans, buy now-pay later, and/or mortgages   A quantitative background in STEM (science, technology, engineering, and mathematics), statistics, economics, or related fields   Fluency in English     Nice to have    Experience in the second line of defence (risk)  Impressive programming skills using Python, R, and/or SQL      Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.   Important notice for candidates:    Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.  •  Only apply through official Revolut channels.   We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.  •  Always double-check the emails you receive.   Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.   We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process.   If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.   By submitting this application, I confirm that all the information given by me in this application for employment and any additional documents attached hereto are true to the best of my knowledge and that I have not wilfully suppressed any material fact. I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Arquitetura Azure
description:
Confira a vaga para Arquitetura Azure em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:    Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com (Azure).     Responsabilidades:     Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).   Implementar o ZeroLayer Router  (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).   Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.   Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).   Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.   Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.   Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.   Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.     Requisitos Obrigatórios     Azure em produção: AKS, VNet, bancos gerenciados, mensageria e IAM   Capacidade de discutir e implementar Cell-Based Architecture   Terraform para IaC multi-célula com pipelines de CI/CD para infra   Kubernetes em produção: rede, RBAC, Helm e autoscaling   Redes: DNS, TLS/PKI, firewalls e roteamento em cloud   Mensageria: Kafka ou equivalente em contexto de roteamento assíncrono   Bancos relacionais e não relacionais em contexto de sharding   Padrões de autenticação: OIDC, OAuth 2.0 e identidades gerenciadas   Observabilidade em produção: métricas, logs e traces distribuídos.     Desejável:     Experiência prévia com Cell-Based Architecture em produção   Visão multicloud: workloads simultâneos em Azure e AWS   ArgoCD (GitOps), incluindo ApplicationSets para deploy em múltiplas células   Service mesh (Istio, Cilium) e mTLS inter-serviço   Datadog: APM, Log Management, SLO tracking e alertas por célula   Certificações: CKA, AZ-305, Terraform Associate ou equivalentes.     Descrição comportamental:     Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja  colaborativa   em suas atribuições;   Tenha  coragem   para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;   Transforme ideias em  soluções criativas   e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;   Tenha habilidades de  resolução de problemas   ;   Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e  gerenciar o próprio tempo   ;   Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e  inovadoras   no âmbito tecnológico.      Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.  #VempraGFT   #VamosVoarJuntos   #ProudToBeGFT

Partner and maintain close communication with Fashion boutique teams to execute training initiatives, ensuring alignment with brand standards and elevating client experience.    2. title: Promo Writer (Brasil)
description:
Confira a vaga para Promo Writer (Brasil) em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Promo Writer   Location: Remote   Position Type: Contract   Company: Pocket FM   About Us    At Pocket FM, our mission is to deliver immersive storytelling experiences to a global audience. We are looking for a creative and detail-oriented Junior Writer to support content localization, AI-driven script adaptation, and storytelling optimization across our audio series.   Role Overview    As a Promo Writer, you will be responsible for creating high-impact promotional scripts for Pocket FM audio series. These promo scripts will be used for performance marketing campaigns across various platforms, including Meta and UAC, and will later be moved into post-production for final execution.   The role requires a strong understanding of ad creation, trailer writing, promo structuring, storytelling hooks, audience retention, emotional pacing, and localized content adaptation. You will write fresh promotional ads from scratch, adapt existing ads from the English team into Brazilian Portuguese, localize them for the target audience, and refine existing ads to improve quality and performance.   You will work closely with creative, editorial, production, and performance marketing teams to deliver production-ready promo scripts and suggest rework hypotheses for non-performing ads.    Key Responsibilities    1. Promo, Trailer & Ad Script Writing    Write fresh promotional ad scripts from scratch for Pocket FM audio series.   Create engaging long-form promo scripts, typically ranging from 30 to 60 minutes, designed to drive listener interest and campaign performance.   Develop strong hooks, emotional beats, cliffhangers, character moments, and narrative setups that make the audience want to start listening to the series.   Write scripts that are clear, engaging, and suitable for audio-first post-production.   Ensure each promo script reflects the core promise, genre, tone, and audience appeal of the series.   2. Adaptation & Localization    Adapt promotional scripts and ad concepts shared by the English team into Brazilian Portuguese.   Localize scripts culturally and emotionally so they feel natural and relevant for the Brazilian audience.   Maintain the original creative intent while improving clarity, relatability, and audience engagement for the local market.   Ensure adapted ads do not feel like direct translations, but like native, market-ready promotional scripts.   3. Script Refinement & Quality Improvement    Review and refine existing promo scripts to improve overall storytelling quality, pacing, emotional impact, and clarity.   Strengthen weak openings, hooks, transitions, character motivations, and call-to-action moments.   Improve scripts based on editorial feedback, performance insights, and creative direction.   Ensure all final scripts are polished, coherent, and aligned with Pocket FM’s creative and quality standards.   4. Production-Ready Script Delivery    Create production-ready promo scripts with clear structure, scene flow, dialogue, narration, emotional cues, and production notes wherever required.   Ensure scripts are easy for voice-over artists, editors, and post-production teams to understand and execute.   Provide clear direction on tone, pauses, dramatic moments, sound cues, and emotional delivery where needed.   Support the production team by ensuring the script intent is preserved during execution.   5. Performance Reworks & Creative Hypotheses    Analyze non-performing ads and suggest creative hypotheses for improvement.   Recommend reworks based on possible issues such as weak hooks, unclear story setup, low emotional impact, poor pacing, or ineffective localization.   Create alternate openings, revised structures, stronger cliffhangers, and improved audience entry points for underperforming promos.   Collaborate with marketing and creative teams to test different ad angles and improve campaign performance.   6. Creative & Editorial Collaboration    Work closely with editorial, production, localization, and performance marketing teams.   Incorporate feedback quickly and deliver revised scripts within timelines.   Maintain consistency in character, tone, story logic, and emotional continuity across promo assets.   Contribute ideas for new promo formats, trailer structures, and ad angles that can improve audience response.   7. AI Tool Usage & Workflow Optimization    Use GenAI and writing tools where required to support ideation, adaptation, translation review, and script refinement.   Apply strong human editorial judgment to ensure AI-assisted work meets narrative, cultural, and quality standards.   Review AI-generated outputs for tone, accuracy, cultural relevance, and storytelling strength.   Use AI tools responsibly to improve speed and quality without compromising creative originality.      Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Literature, Creative Writing, Media, Communications, Journalism, Film, or a related field.   Strong writing and storytelling skills, especially for audio, ads, trailers, promos, or digital content.   Excellent command of Brazilian Portuguese, with strong understanding of local cultural nuances, expressions, and audience preferences.   Good understanding of English, with the ability to adapt English scripts and concepts into natural Brazilian Portuguese.   Strong sense of narrative structure, emotional pacing, character motivation, hooks, and cliffhangers.   Experience in promo writing, ad scriptwriting, trailer writing, fiction writing, audio storytelling, content localization, or digital performance creatives is preferred.   Ability to write production-ready scripts with clear directions for voice-over and post-production teams.   Ability to analyze feedback and performance signals to improve creative output.   Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain quality across multiple deliverables.   Comfortable working in a fast-paced content and performance marketing environment.   Familiarity with AI-based writing, translation, or content adaptation tools is a plus.      Ideal Candidate    The ideal candidate is a strong storyteller who understands how to turn an audio series into a compelling promotional experience. They should know how to grab attention quickly, build emotional curiosity, create drama, and write scripts that make audiences want to listen further.   They should be equally comfortable writing original promo scripts, adapting English ads into Brazilian Portuguese, refining existing scripts, and suggesting creative reworks for ads that are not performing well.

title: Professor de francês
description:

Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online:  você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.     Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco.   Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.   *Esta não é uma vaga CLT*    O que oferecemos? Mentorias semanais   com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.   Plataforma  exclusiva   para acompanhamento das aulas.   Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.   Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.   Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).   Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.   Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.     Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?    Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você  .     Necessário:     Maior de 18 anos   , fluente em Português e outro idioma.   Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais   para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.   Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.   Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.     O diferencial?    Aqui você é mais que um professor.     Você será parte de  uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas   , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.    Esta  não é uma vaga CLT   , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.    Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.    Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a  ii   com certeza é o seu lugar.    Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas.   Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!   O que eu faço?    Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida   Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as   Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados   Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as   Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as   Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as     Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.    QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?   Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.   Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.   Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.     Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.    Seja diferente, seja independente

As plantas estão distribuídas entre a produção de painéis, em três fábricas localizadas nas cidades de Jaguariaíva (PR), Ponta Grossa (PR) e Montenegro (RS); painéis e molduras, na planta localizada em Piên (PR); resinas e químicos, na unidade de Araucária (PR) e, em 2027, prepara-se para inaugurar sua primeira fábrica de celulose branqueada em Inocência (MS). A companhia também foi a primeira do mundo a receber a certificação Carbono Neutro, em 2020, emitida pela Delloite e auditada pela Price Waterhouse. Globalmente e no país, opera primando pela gestão responsável da água, a conservação da biodiversidade e a retirada de gás carbônico da atmosfera.    Quer fazer parte do nosso time? Então, se inscreva em nossa oportunidade.     Todas as nossas oportunidades são destinadas para pessoas com ou sem deficiência. title: QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil
description:
Nova oportunidade para QC Analyst - Audio Content - Brazil em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

About Us    Pocket FM is the world’s largest audio-series platform, where powerful stories travel effortlessly across languages, cultures, and continents. From India and the US to Europe and beyond, we are redefining how stories are created, discovered, and experienced across the globe, without screens.    At our core, we are an AI-powered entertainment company with a deeply human-first philosophy. We believe technology should amplify creativity. Our proprietary AI systems work alongside writers, voice artists, and creative teams to help stories scale globally, faster, smarter, and with cultural depth and emotional integrity intact.    Today, Pocket FM is home to a vibrant community of 250+ million listeners, 300,000+ creators, and 100,000+ audio series. With over 140 billion minutes streamed annually, we have emerged as one of the fastest-growing media-tech companies in the world, and we are just getting started. We operate at a massive global scale, but with a startup mindset: curious, fast-moving, and deeply owner-driven. At Pocket FM, teams are encouraged to think boldly, move with intent, and build for long-term impact as we shape the future of audio-first storytelling worldwide.    Role Overview     As a QC Analyst - Audio Content, you will be responsible for reviewing and ensuring the quality, accuracy, and consistency of audio files across different stages of production. This includes raw voice files submitted by voice-over artists and mastered audio files (with SFX and music) delivered by agencies. You will work closely with voice artists, agencies, and internal teams to ensure all audio content aligns with scripts, quality guidelines, and storytelling objectives.    Key Responsibilities    1. Audio Quality Control (Raw & Mastered Files)   Review raw voice-over recordings to ensure clarity, acting, delivery, pronunciation, tone, pacing, and adherence to script.   Evaluate mastered audio files (SFX + background music) for overall listening experience, sound ambiences, balance, and quality standards.   Ensure all audio assets meet defined QC guidelines and Specs before approval.    2. Script-to-Audio Alignment    Verify that audio delivery accurately follows the approved script, including dialogue, tone, and emotional expression.   Identify and flag mismatches, missing lines, or deviations in narration.    3. Technical & Creative Accuracy    Check audio for:   Voice clarity and consistency   Emotional delivery and storytelling effectiveness   Background noise or distortions   Timing and pacing issues   Proper integration of SFX and music in mastered files   Grammatically incorrect words/sentences   Physical noise of voice artist   Abrupt cut / jerk   Sibilance   Fumble / mumble    4. Vendor & Artist Coordination    Collaborate with voice-over artists and external agencies to communicate QC feedback.     Ensure timely implementation of revisions and re-submissions.    5. QC Documentation & Tracking    Provide detailed QC feedback at timecode (TC) level.   Update QC comments and statuses in internal tools or Excel trackers based on show type (AI and PGC content).   Maintain records for submissions, revisions, approvals, and delivery timelines.    6. Pre-Release Quality Checks    Ensure all audio files are QC-approved before publishing or release on the platform.   Validate that final output meets both technical and creative standards.    7. Cross-Team Collaboration    Work closely with writers, production teams, post production agencies, and content managers to ensure seamless audio quality.   Align with internal guidelines and storytelling expectations across shows.    8. Process Improvement    Identify recurring audio quality issues across voice artists or agencies.   Recommend improvements to QC processes, guidelines, and production workflows.   Understand how an audience reacts to certain genres of content to connect with the audience   Stay abreast with changes in the voice requirements and technology    9. Volume & Deadline Management    Handle QC for approximately 80 hours of audio content   within defined timelines.   Maintain high-quality standards while managing large volumes of content.    10. AI Voice Quality Review & Enhancement    Review AI-generated voice content to identify issues impacting listener experience, including but not limited to:   Accent inconsistencies and unnatural speech patterns   Mispronunciations and incorrect word stress   Lack of emotion, expression, or character differentiation   Robotic delivery, pacing irregularities, or unnatural pauses   Voice continuity and tonal inconsistencies across episodes   Contextually inappropriate emphasis or dialogue delivery     Perform basic audio patchwork and corrective edits using approved audio editing tools to address identified issues wherever feasible.    Document AI voice-related observations with clear, actionable feedback at the time-code level and track recurring issues to support model improvements and production quality enhancements.    Collaborate with AI production, content, and post-production teams to ensure continuous improvement in AI-generated audio quality and listener engagement.    Qualifications    Bachelor’s degree in Audio Engineering, Media, Communications, or a related field.   Strong understanding of audio production, voice modulation, and sound design basics.   Experience in audio quality control, podcast production, or voice-over review is preferred.   Familiarity with audio editing tools (Audition, Audacity, or similar) is a plus.   Ability to review both AI-generated and professionally generated (PGC) content.   Excellent attention to detail and auditory judgment.   Strong organizational and documentation skills.   Ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders in a fast-paced production environment.   Proficiency in audio editing tools such as Adobe Audition, Audacity, or similar software for basic audio corrections and patchwork.     Language requirements    Fluent Portugese   Professional working proficiency in English     This role will be working with stakeholders in English on a regular basis.    Salary for this position is R$ $3800 - $4100 BRL.

Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparência, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?   Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.    Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento. Demonstrar vontade de aprender e conhecer.   Estar alinhado ao Propósito e Valores da companhia.   Ser ágil, dinâmico e proativo.   Organização, foco, resiliência, flexibilidade, adaptação, dinamismo e atenção à detalhes.     Será um destaque seu perfil com:    Vivência em Consultoria de TI.     Onde você vai trabalhar? title: Arquitetura de Soluções Azure - 134713
description:
Confira a vaga para Arquitetura de Soluções Azure - 134713 em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

O que buscamos:    Profissional de nível Arquitetura que atue com  Cloud Azure) para atuação remota e contratação CLT.     Responsabilidades:     Fundar o ambiente Azure dentro do ecossistema multicloud do ZeroLayer Platform, projetando o modelo de isolamento entre células (shard key, blast radius e static stability) e implementando o Control Plane (shard map, registro de tenants e lifecycle de células).   Implementar o ZeroLayer Router  (autenticação, TLS e lookup do shard map) e o ZeroLayer Router Kafka (isolamento de tópicos por tenant), definindo estratégia de autenticação sem lock-in (OIDC, mTLS).   Definir engines relacionais e não relacionais por célula, projetando sharding alinhado ao tenant key, com réplicas, failover e criptografia em repouso e trânsito de forma agnóstica ao provider.   Estabelecer padrões de IaC (Terraform) com módulos reutilizáveis por célula e desenhar pipeline CI/CD completo (lint, plan, gates de aprovação, apply e drift detection), suportando o ciclo completo da célula (criação, atualização, re-shard e destruição rastreável).   Provisionar AKS por célula com isolamento de rede e Network Policies, projetar topologia de VNet (subnets, peering, conectividade cross-cloud) e gerenciar ciclo de vida de certificados TLS de forma automatizada.   Implementar autenticação com provider agnóstico (OIDC/OAuth 2.0), configurar identidades gerenciadas sem segredos estáticos e estabelecer RBAC por célula com princípio de menor privilégio.   Implementar estratégia de observabilidade por célula (métricas, logs e traces distribuídos), operando Datadog como plataforma principal (APM, Log Management, dashboards e alertas baseados em SLO), garantindo rastreabilidade ponta a ponta com correlation IDs.   Documentar decisões em ADRs e diagramas de arquitetura.     Requisitos Obrigatórios     Larga experiência em Arquitetura de Soluções, Arquitetura de Software ou Cloud Architecture.   Experiência prática em arquitetura Azure e implementação de soluções em cloud.   Arquitetura de microsserviços utilizando Domain-Driven Design (DDD).   Arquitetura Celular, Control Plane, Data Plane e Shard Map.   Experiência com Cell-Based Architecture em produção.   APIs REST, gRPC e arquitetura baseada em contratos.   Arquiteturas orientadas a eventos utilizando plataformas como Kafka, Event Hubs ou equivalentes.   Bancos relacionais, NoSQL, cache distribuído e estratégias de sharding.   OAuth2, OpenID Connect e provedores modernos de identidade.   Observabilidade distribuída (logs, métricas, tracing e SLOs).   Architecture Reviews e elaboração de ADRs.   Experiência no setor Financeiro     Desejável:     Experiência com Zero-Failure Architecture.   CQRS.   Event Sourcing.   Saga Pattern.   Outbox Pattern.   Consumer Driven Contracts.   GraphQL.   Apache Pulsar, RabbitMQ ou outras plataformas de mensageria.   Java, Go ou .NET.   Experiência em ambientes multicloud (Azure e AWS).   Microsoft Certified: Azure Solutions Architect Expert (AZ-305).   Outras certificações Microsoft Azure (AZ-104, AZ-204, AI-102).   TOGAF.   Participação em pré-vendas técnicas ou definição de arquiteturas corporativas.   Conhecimento de Terraform     Descrição comportamental:     Procuramos uma pessoa que:   Goste de trabalhar em equipe e seja  colaborativa   em suas atribuições;   Tenha  coragem   para se desafiar e ir além, abraçando novas oportunidades de crescimento;   Transforme ideias em  soluções criativas   e busque qualidade em toda sua rotina;   Tenha habilidades de  resolução de problemas   ;   Possua habilidade e se sinta confortável para trabalhar de forma independente e  gerenciar o próprio tempo   ;   Tenha interesse em lidar com situações adversas e  inovadoras   no âmbito tecnológico.     Big enough to deliver – small enough to care.  #VempraGFT   #VamosVoarJuntos   #ProudToBeGFT

title: ANALISTA DE OPERAÇÕES E CONTRATAÇÃO DE TRANSPORTES
description:

Imbituba/SC  Disponibilidade para início imediato    A Melo Logística está buscando um profissional para integrar sua equipe operacional, atuando diretamente na contratação, programação e acompanhamento de motoristas e transportadores.    Nossa operação envolve transporte rodoviário de granel, carga geral e contêineres, além do atendimento logístico de operações de carga e descarga de navios.    QUAL SERÁ A SUA MISSÃO?   Garantir que cada operação tenha os motoristas, veículos e transportadores necessários, dentro dos horários programados, acompanhando as demandas desde a contratação até a conclusão do serviço.    PRINCIPAIS RESPONSABILIDADES   • Prospectar, negociar, contratar e mobilizar motoristas, agregados e transportadores;  • Programar veículos para operações rodoviárias e portuárias;  • Confirmar a disponibilidade dos motoristas e acompanhar o cumprimento das programações;  • Acompanhar carregamentos, deslocamentos, entregas e o atendimento das operações de navios;  • Manter contato constante com motoristas, clientes e equipe operacional;  • Organizar prioridades e realizar ajustes quando houver alterações na programação;  • Atuar na solução de atrasos, faltas de veículos, mudanças de horário e demais ocorrências operacionais;  • Atualizar controles, registros e informações da operação;  • Acompanhar cada demanda até sua efetiva conclusão.    PERFIL QUE BUSCAMOS    Procuramos um profissional com postura ativa, senso de responsabilidade e capacidade de acompanhar a operação de ponta a ponta.    É necessário ter:   • Experiência em operações de transporte, programação de veículos, contratação de fretes ou atividades relacionadas;  • Boa comunicação e capacidade de negociação;  • Organização para conduzir várias demandas simultaneamente;  • Agilidade para tomar decisões e resolver problemas operacionais;  • Comprometimento com horários, programações e resultados;  • Facilidade para trabalhar com sistemas, planilhas e ferramentas de comunicação;  • Disponibilidade para atuar em finais de semana e, quando necessário, acompanhar operações fora do horário comercial, conforme a programação operacional;  • Disponibilidade para início imediato;  • Disponibilidade para trabalhar presencialmente em Imbituba/SC.    SERÃO CONSIDERADOS DIFERENCIAIS   • Experiência com contratação de motoristas, agregados e transportadores terceiros;  • Carteira de contatos ativa de motoristas e transportadores;  • Experiência com operações portuárias ou atendimento de navios;  • Conhecimento em transporte de granel, carga geral ou contêineres;  • Experiência anterior em transportadora, operador logístico ou empresa de agenciamento de cargas.    SOBRE A ROTINA    Esta é uma oportunidade para quem se identifica com o ambiente operacional do transporte.   As programações rodoviárias e portuárias são dinâmicas e podem sofrer alterações de horários, volumes e prioridades. Por isso, buscamos alguém com disponibilidade real, dedicação e responsabilidade para acompanhar as demandas e agir rapidamente quando necessário.   O profissional estará no centro da operação, contribuindo diretamente para que motoristas, veículos, clientes e equipe estejam alinhados e para que cada serviço seja concluído conforme o planejado.   Interessados devem se candidatar pelo LinkedIn, destacando sua experiência com operações de transporte, programação de veículos e contratação de motoristas ou transportadores.

description:

Job Title:   Product Owner  Location:   Remote (Brazil) with occasional in person meetings in Curitiba   Contract:   3 Year Contract   About the Role    We are looking for an experienced Product Owner to join our team on a long term contract. This role is ideal for someone who is highly organized, thrives in Agile environments, and can work independently while collaborating closely with cross functional teams. You will serve as the right hand to the Product Manager, helping drive product initiatives from discovery through delivery.   The ideal candidate has strong Product Owner experience, excellent communication skills in English, and is comfortable managing priorities with minimal supervision.   Key Responsibilities    Partner closely with the Product Manager to execute the product strategy and roadmap.   Own and manage the product backlog, ensuring priorities align with business goals.   Write clear user stories and define acceptance criteria.   Collaborate with engineering, QA, business stakeholders, and Scrum teams throughout the development lifecycle.   Facilitate backlog refinement, sprint planning, sprint reviews, and other Agile ceremonies.   Clarify business requirements and remove ambiguities for the development team.   Monitor product progress and proactively identify risks or blockers.   Act as the primary point of contact for day to day product decisions.    Required Qualifications   8 to 12 years of professional experience, including significant experience as a Product Owner.   Strong knowledge of Agile methodologies and Scrum.   Experience managing product backlogs and prioritization.   Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.   Ability to work independently with minimal supervision in Product Owner responsibilities.   Strong stakeholder management and collaboration skills.    Preferred Experience    Experience in at least one of the following domains is highly desirable, listed in order of preference:   Oil and Gas   Foreign Trade and Trade Compliance   SAP Implementation projects   Supply Chain & Logistics    Candidates without experience in these industries are still encouraged to apply if they are eager to learn topics such as Oil and Gas, Product Classification and Compliance, Foreign Trade, and SAP, while already demonstrating strong Product Owner capabilities and the ability to work independently.   What We're Looking For    Self motivated and proactive professional.   Strong analytical and problem solving skills.   Excellent organizational and prioritization abilities.   Comfortable working with distributed, cross functional teams.   Passion for delivering value through iterative product development.

title: Operations Lead
description:

About PerkUp   PerkUp is a fast-growing HR Tech startup disrupting the $242B corporate gifting industry. Our platform lets employers send high-quality swag, gifts, gift cards, and rewards to employees globally—with on-demand fulfillment, 9 warehouses across 4 continents, and 60+ HRIS integrations. To learn more, visit perkupapp.com.    We are seeking an Operations Lead to own and continuously improve the flow of products through our global fulfillment network—from the purchasing handoff through receiving, inventory, fulfillment, and delivery. You will be the primary point of contact for our 3PLs, directly lead one operations coordinator from day one, and personally handle a meaningful share of the execution.    This is a hands-on player-coach role. You will create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve inventory and order issues, coordinate process changes and system migrations, and make sure work does not become orphaned after it is delegated.    The right person is smart, ambitious, technically curious, and highly accountable. You do not need a perfect background in every tool or workflow, but you must learn quickly, think clearly when the process breaks, and push problems to resolution without waiting for step-by-step direction.    This role is fully remote and works a full Eastern Time schedule.    What you’ll own    Own day-to-day relationships with our global 3PL partners, including SLAs, escalations, performance, onboarding, and migrations.   Directly manage and develop one operations coordinator through clear goals, delegation, review, coaching, and accountability.   Create and review ASNs, follow up on inbound shipments, resolve receiving discrepancies, and protect inventory accuracy.   Coordinate closely with the purchasing team to ensure a clean handoff from purchase order through warehouse availability.   Monitor fulfillment and delivery, investigate exceptions and aging orders, and drive issues through resolution.   Diagnose Shopify, WMS, and order-sync problems; gather evidence, coordinate with partners and engineering, and validate the fix.   Lead new warehouse requirements, process changes, documentation, SOPs, dashboards, and operating controls.   Track performance, identify recurring failure points, and build systems that reduce escalations and founder involvement.     What success looks like    Fulfillment, receiving, ASN, and inventory accuracy improve measurably.   Operational issues have clear owners, move quickly, and do not get lost between teams or vendors.   Your direct report and 3PL partners operate with stronger consistency, accountability, and independence.   PerkUp’s fulfillment operation scales without requiring daily founder involvement.     What we’re looking for   3+ years of experience in logistics, supply chain, fulfillment, ecommerce, marketplace, or another complex operations environment.   A track record of independently solving ambiguous operational problems and taking accountability for outcomes.   Experience directly managing or materially leading another operator.   Strong systems and technical aptitude—you can understand data flows, troubleshoot integrations, and communicate effectively with technical teams.   Excellent written and spoken English; full professional fluency is required.   Strong communication and vendor-management skills across remote teams.   Active, sophisticated use of AI tools to research, analyze, document, and move faster—while verifying the output.   A player-coach mindset: willing to do the work yourself, raise the bar for others, and stay effective under pressure.   Goal-oriented, competitive, and motivated by increasing responsibility, impact, and career growth.   Shopify and ASN experience are preferred, but neither is a hard requirement if you can demonstrate exceptional learning speed and relevant systems thinking.     Role details    Location: Remote, Latin America   Schedule: Full-time, working Eastern Time   Engagement: Full-time contractor  $4,500–$5,000 USD per month     Growth path    This role is designed for someone who wants to grow with the company. Strong performance can lead to broader ownership and a path toward Head of Operations and, over time, senior operations leadership as PerkUp scales.

Atualizar informações cadastrais e acadêmicas dos alunos nos sistemas institucionais.   Apoiar campanhas e ações de relacionamento com alunos.   Contribuir para a melhoria contínua dos processos de atendimento e da experiência do estudante.   Zelar pela qualidade, cordialidade e excelência no atendimento prestado. Desejável cursando ou concluído Ensino Superior    Experiência prévia com atendimento ao cliente, preferencialmente em instituições de ensino.   Conhecimento básico de rotinas administrativas.   Familiaridade com Pacote Office (Word, Excel e Outlook).   Desejável experiência com sistemas acadêmicos e plataformas de atendimento. title: Client Success Manager (SMMA)
description:
Nova oportunidade para Client Success Manager (SMMA) em santa catarina. Saiba mais sobre essa vaga.

Client Success Manager — 2URN Marketing   Location: Remote Type: Full-time Reports to: COO Comp: $2,000 + $ bonuses tied to retention & client results and revneu share (3% of renewals + 10% Upsells)    Read this part first   Most agencies hand a roofer a login and a monthly report and call it service. We don't do that. We come into roofing companies internally and build — the funnel, the CRM, the follow-up, the reporting, the process their office actually runs on. Our clients don't buy leads from us. They buy a lead engine we install and then operate alongside their team.   That means this is not a check-in-and-take-notes job. You are the person inside the client's business making the machine work. If you like owning outcomes and hate babysitting inboxes, keep reading.    What you'll actually own   You'll carry a book of roofing contractor accounts from signed contract through their entire life with us.   Launch (first 24–72 hours after a client signs)  Run the onboarding call and pull everything the build needs: service area, offer, pricing, photos, reviews, brand assets, calendar availability.   Stand up their GoHighLevel sub-account: pipeline, calendar, lead-intake workflows, SMS + email follow-up, call routing.   Get their landing page live and their form wired to the CRM — then test it yourself by submitting a real lead and watching it land.   Confirm tracking fires end to end before a dollar of ad spend goes out.    We launch clients in days, not weeks. That deadline is yours to hold.   Ongoing (where the job really lives)  Watch every account's numbers daily: leads, cost per lead, show rate, booked inspections, closed jobs. Know which of your accounts is drifting before the client does.   Run weekly and monthly client calls. Walk them through what's working, what isn't, and what you're changing — in plain English, not ad-platform jargon.   Be the bridge to the media buyer and creative team. When CPL climbs or leads stop booking, you diagnose whether it's ads, the offer, the follow-up, or the client's own sales process — and you route it to the right person with the data attached.   Coach the client's office staff on speed-to-lead and follow-up. Half of a bad month is a roofer who isn't calling leads back in five minutes. Your job is to say that out loud, kindly, with the call logs to prove it.   Keep every account's notes, action items, and next steps current in the CRM and in ClickUp. If it isn't written down, it didn't happen.   Spot expansion honestly: more markets, more spend, add-on programs — but only when the core engine is already producing.    Retention   Own renewal and churn risk for your book. You should know which client is unhappy two weeks before they tell you.   Run save conversations yourself. Bring the numbers, own what we got wrong, and come with a fix, not an apology.    What we measure you on   Client retention and length of stay   On-time launches (live inside the promised window)  Account health: leads delivered, CPL against target, show rate, booked jobs   Speed of response to client issues   CRM/ClickUp hygiene — notes, action items, and reporting actually current    Who this is for  2+ years in account management, client success, or agency service — or you've run operations inside a home-services company and know the trade from inside.   Comfortable in a CRM every single day. We run GoHighLevel — if you know it, say so loudly in your application. If you don't, you need to be the kind of person who'll learn a platform cold in two weeks.   You can read an ad account report and tell a story with it. You don't need to be a media buyer, but you must know what cost per lead, show rate, and cost per booked job mean and what makes each one move.   Direct communicator. Our clients are roofing owners and GMs. They want straight answers, not marketing vocabulary.   Organized without being reminded. You'll juggle a dozen accounts, each with its own build state, spend level, and open items.   Thick skin and a spine. Sometimes the honest answer is \"your team isn't calling the leads.\" You have to be able to say it.    Bonus points for: home services / roofing / construction background, Meta Ads Manager familiarity, funnel building, ClickUp, experience owning a renewal number.    What you get   A real book of business and the authority to actually fix things, not just escalate them.   Direct access to the founder and the build team — no layers.   A company that already has the delivery figured out: 26+ roofing clients served and 14,676 leads generated to date, backed by a 100,000-dollars-in- signed-jobs-in-90-days guarantee. You're not selling a promise; you're operating something that works.   Unlimited PTO / Learning Oppertunities

Experiência prática e aprofundada com as APIs da OpenAI e/ou Gemini.   Domínio em frameworks de construção de aplicações com LLMs, como LangChain, e familiaridade com a implementação do Model Context Protocol.   Conhecimento avançado no ecossistema de nuvem (preferencialmente Azure) e padrões de arquitetura baseada em microsserviços.   Vivência com bancos de dados NoSQL (como MongoDB) e ferramentas de mensageria/eventos (como MassTransit). A Fundação Araucária, em parceria com o IEL Paraná, oferece às empresas paranaenses um programa inovador que conecta seu negócio a doutores profissionais. O  Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial   oportunizará expertise técnica, científica e metodológica, essenciais para impulsionar o crescimento, a inovação e aumentar a sustentabilidade da sua empresa, fortalecendo seu posicionamento no cenário competitivo.  O programa oferece  bolsas para a inserção de doutores em empresas paranaenses   , promovendo o desenvolvimento científico, tecnológico e de inovação. Os bolsistas atuarão diretamente na empresa, contribuindo com  conhecimento de ponta e soluções personalizadas para o mercado   , ancoradas na ciência e em evidências robustas.   Mais do que uma ponte entre academia e setor produtivo, o programa fomenta a  aplicação prática do conhecimento científico   , favorecendo a transformação de pesquisas em  inovações reais, com alto impacto socioeconômico   . A atuação dos doutores promove a cultura da ciência nas organizações, estimula a  tomada de decisão baseada em dados e evidências   , e potencializa a  capacidade de resolver desafios complexos de forma criativa e sustentável   . Com forte interface entre engenharia, inovação e transformação digital, a empresa busca elevar a produtividade e a maturidade tecnológica de processos críticos em BIM.   Neste projeto, a atuação será voltada à automação de processos críticos com ênfase na gestão e nos BIM, por meio do desenvolvimento, validação e disponibilização do Plugin M Techne em ambiente operacional real. A iniciativa envolve desenvolver uma solução tecnológica integrada aos processos internos e ao ecossistema BIM, capaz de automatizar verificações técnicas, dimensionamento paramétrico, auditoria de conformidade e documentação de projetos.   Se você tem perfil analítico, interesse em tecnologia, engenharia, BIM e automação de processos, essa é uma oportunidade para contribuir com uma solução inovadora voltada ao aumento de produtividade, redução de retrabalho e avanço da transformação digital na cadeia da construção civil.    Projeto:    Automação de processos críticos para gestão e para o BIM, através do Plugin M Techne.    Formação Acadêmica:   Engenharia Civil, Engenharia de Produção, Ciência da Computação, Automação ou Sistemas de Informação.    Principais Atividades:    Atuar como executor técnico-científico do projeto, diretamente na construção da solução entre a engenharia e o desenvolvimento;   Realizar a modelagem prática das lógicas de automação;   Traduzir normas e processos críticos em regras de decisão aplicáveis ao ecossistema BIM e aos sistemas de gestão corporativa;   Elaborar e executar integralmente os protocolos de testes experimentais;   Operar em projetos reais para identificar falhas e acertos;   Desenhar ativamente os fluxos de usabilidade UX/UI da ferramenta;   Coletar, calcular e analisar os indicadores de desempenho no dia a dia;   Comprovar a redução de retrabalho, o ganho de produtividade e a gestão de informações;   Redigir toda a documentação técnico-científica que atestará a maturidade e a escalabilidade das soluções para o mercado da construção civil.     Requisitos Técnicos Mínimos:    Entendimento da metodologia BIM: Operação em softwares de modelagem e domínio dos fluxos de projetos;   Domínio de Inteligência Artificial: Conhecimento avançado na aplicação prática de IA, compreensão de modelos e capacidade de estruturar lógicas e interagir com as ferramentas inteligentes já utilizadas no desenvolvimento;   Lógica e Processos: Capacidade de interpretar normas de projetos e traduzi-las em fluxogramas de decisão e regras de automação;   Análise de Dados: Domínio de ferramentas (Excel Avançado, Power BI) para coleta e cálculo de indicadores de desempenho (KPIs).     Requisitos Técnicos Desejáveis / Diferenciais:    Interoperabilidade: Conhecimento aprofundado em OpenBIM e manipulação de arquivos IFC;   Qualidade de Software (QA): Experiência na criação e execução de protocolos de testes, validação de ferramentas digitais e registro de bugs;   Prototipação e UX/UI: Habilidade básica em ferramentas como Figma ou Miro para desenhar fluxos de telas focados na usabilidade de engenheiros;   Background em P&D: Vivência anterior na execução de projetos de pesquisa aplicada e inovação tecnológica voltados para o setor de arquitetura, engenharia e construção (AEC).     Valor da bolsa (mensal)  : Bolsista (Doutor) R$ 5.000 – Programa Doutores Inovando no Setor Empresarial   Formato de trabalho   : Híbrido (Com possibilidade de 100% remoto) - Curitiba/PR. Key Responsibilities    Design, implement, and maintain the  risk management framework   (operational, credit, liquidity, market, and technology risk) required for PSAV authorization under BCB regulations.   Own the  internal controls structure   , ensuring alignment with BCB Resolutions 519/520/ ) and related normative instructions (IN 704/2026, IN 739/2026).   Serve as a  named statutory officer   in the company's licensing application and corporate documentation, representing the company before the BCB on risk-related matters.   Conduct ongoing  risk assessments   of virtual asset operations, custody arrangements, and third-party service providers (PSRs).   Coordinate with the AML/Compliance Officer and Cybersecurity Officer to ensure a cohesive risk governance structure across the three regulatory pillars   Prepare and maintain documentation supporting  capital adequacy   and prudential requirements as they apply to VASP-specific activities (RWA calculation methodologies, as clarified by evolving BCB guidance).   Lead or coordinate the  independent assurance report   process (IN 739/2026) with CVM-registered audit firms.   Represent OSL in engagements with BCB, CVM, and industry associations on risk-related regulatory workstreams.   Monitor regulatory developments and proactively adjust internal risk policies as the VASP framework evolves.   Report regularly to senior leadership and support the Board/Executive team with risk metrics and escalations.     Requirements    Bachelor's degree in Law, Economics, Business Administration, Finance, or related field.   Strong experience   in risk management and/or internal controls within regulated financial institutions in Brazil (banks, payment institutions, brokerages, or asset managers).   Solid working knowledge of  BCB regulatory processes, norms, and resolutions.    Prior experience engaging directly with BCB and/or CVM in a regulatory/supervisory context.   Strong understanding of prudential risk frameworks (capital, RWA, operational risk).   Brazilian national or foreign national with valid Brazilian residency (statutory officer requirement).   Availability and willingness to be formally listed as a company officer with associated legal responsibilities.   Fluent Portuguese and Advanced English.     Preferred Qualifications    Prior experience in virtual assets, crypto, or fintech risk management.   Familiarity with VASP-specific prudential frameworks and evolving BCB guidance on RWA treatment for digital asset activities.   Experience working with external legal counsel and audit firms on regulatory submissions.   Professional certifications in risk management (e.g., FRM, CRM) a plus.     P/S: Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted due to overwhelming applicants.     Vision & Mission    OSL is the first SFC-licensed digital asset platform in Hong Kong and a PayFi innovator. Through stablecoin payments, cross-border settlement and global licensing, we are building the next-generation payments network. Stablecoins have become everyday money across emerging markets and are widely viewed as blockchain's \"killer app,\" with industry focus shifting from token issuance to real-world consumer and enterprise payment adoption. The strongest growth lies in cross-border B2B payments, where providers embedding stablecoins into corporate settlement flows can capture significant volume and float. Long-term defensibility comes from regulatory licences, banking partners and cross-border corridors.    OSL holds or has acquired licences in Hong Kong, Japan, Australia, Bermuda and Indonesia, and is expanding into Europe, Brazil, Southeast Asia and Africa through acquisitions and licence applications. With OSL Pay and StableX, we embed stablecoin settlement into bank accounts and card networks, support 150+ digital assets, and provide 24/7 fiat–stablecoin conversion. As a regulated pioneer with a startup mindset, we believe the future of payments will be driven by real adoption and scalable deployment, not technology narratives. We welcome builders who are passionate about crypto and payments to join us in shaping compliant, global payment infrastructure.

title: Project Manager
description:

This is a fully remote position, independent contractor (PJ) and salary is 25/hr USD.    Job Capsule:    The Project Manager’s typical area of responsibility includes one or more projects and/or multiple delivery teams across the domain. This includes development, configuration, validation, deployment, and launch of customer solutions, such as PM projects, country or multi-country deployments. Each project may be structured as a series of cumulative Minimum Viable Products (MVPn), with delivery timelines ranging from three months to one year.    This PM will be responsible for the delivery of assigned projects and cross-team initiatives in compliance with the triple constraints of time, budget, and quality. They will challenge Product Owners and platoon/team members on priorities, supports efficient decision-making across teams, and keeps scope aligned with capacity and stakeholder requirements. They will foster an effective working environment by protecting teams from illegitimate influences during sprints and identifying and removing obstacles early.    This PM is the project focal point for stakeholders who are not direct team members and helps ensure clear communication across project teams, PMO, management, and domain stakeholders. When possible, they will also promote the project or related domain initiatives across the organization and externally.    This PM will work closely with the PMO to align processes, reporting standards, and governance practices across the domain. This includes coordinating with multiple teams, ensuring consistent visibility into project status, and tracking cross-team dependencies to support timely decision-making and delivery.    Because typical team members and project stakeholders may be distributed around the world, they must demonstrate strong self-organization, the ability to work effectively across time zones, and the discipline to coordinate multiple teams without overextending themselves while ensuring delivery meets the expected level of quality.    Job Responsibilities    Overall    Function as moderator and coach for platoons and project teams. Promote an atmosphere of ownership, trust, and enthusiasm; facilitate alignment within teams and across the broader domain.   Onboard new platoon and project team members to Agile and DevOps ways of working.   Engage, influence, and collaborate with internal Halliburton Landmark and HDS teams such as R&D, CloudOps, Customer Success, Performance Engineering, and PMO.   Partner with PMO to align project management processes, reporting cadence, and governance expectations across the domain   Coordinate with multiple teams to maintain clear ownership, communication, and alignment on shared priorities and delivery commitments    Quality management    Set the project framework, governance and guidelines   Standardize tools when feasible (OpenEarth, AzureDevOps, Teams, Figma, iEnergy, etc.)  Provide best practices to platoons and project teams in Agile and DevOps methodologies and processes. In particular, organize, prepare, moderate, and track team ceremonies:   Release Planning (MVPn and MVPn+1 to many)  Sprint planning, incl. commitment to working agreements   Pre-planning   Daily Scrum   Sprint retrospective, incl. definition of done   Create the backlog and assign stories to sprints. Ensure stories match stakeholder expectations   Ensure teams follow the Built For Core (B4C) and Back To Community (B2C) governance process.   Help liaise with other SmartDigital projects and teams to support rapid knowledge sharing and alignment.    Time management    Provide regular updates to management, stakeholders, and PMO. Create standardized reports, including burn-down charts and other metrics relevant for process transparency across teams and the domain.   Project and measure team velocity and delivery across assigned teams. Ensure team members remain focused on priorities and are contributing toward shared delivery goals.   Identify and manage project risks, issues, and cross-team dependencies.   Track and manage cross-team dependencies, risks, and follow-ups to ensure blockers are visible and addressed in a timely manner    Cost management    Plan and mobilize teams for MVPn and, where applicable, MVPn+1 and other related projects to support capacity planning, bench creation, and resource alignment across the domain.   Hire and manage 3rd party vendors where appropriate.   Ensure proper budgeting and prioritization process   Reports on a regular basis project costs against budget. Realigns resources, budget or expectations to fit.    Requirements    Formal   4 year college degree, preferred in Engineering or Computer Science  2-4 years leading Agile or DevOps teams, preferably certified as Scrum Master. Experience in cloud architecture desired    Informal    Excellent technical, coaching and communication skills   Leadership without authority, appreciation, empathy and motivational persuasiveness   Service minded, structured, will-do attitude   Skilled at detecting, understanding and solving problems (organizational and technical)   Bonus    Knowledge of Upstream Oil and Gas, Well Construction practice, or Drilling Supervision would bring added value and more fungibility for future roles.

Buscamos profissionais que querem se desenvolver junto com o negócio e que estejam preparados para grandes desafios: da infraestrutura que move o Brasil às soluções sustentáveis que protegem o amanhã. Gestão de Riscos: Identificar preventivamente riscos jurídicos, propor soluções de mitigação e estruturar fluxos de governança para as áreas corporativas. Requisitos da vaga:     Formação em Direito;   Pós-graduação em Direito Empresarial, Direito Contratual ou áreas correlatas;   Sólida experiência em Contratos e Consultoria Jurídica Empresarial, preferencialmente em grandes empresas ou grupos econômicos;   Atuação em temas estratégicos de alta responsabilidade, incluindo negociações complexas, gestão de riscos e suporte à alta administração;   Capacidade de liderar projetos e estruturar processos entre o Jurídico e áreas parceiras, especialmente Suprimentos, promovendo eficiência e governança;   Inglês fluente;   Habilidade de comunicação, com foco em reportes executivos objetivos e orientados à tomada de decisão. Habilidades e atitudes:     Perfil Protagonista: Postura proativa, orientada a propor soluções inovadoras e tomar a iniciativa frente a desafios organizacionais;   Articulação e Visão Sistêmica: Capacidade de navegar e se comunicar de maneira construtiva entre diferentes níveis hierárquicos e diretorias parceiras;   Foco em Resultados: Orientação voltada a garantir agilidade nos prazos e segurança jurídica em cenários dinâmicos;   Resiliência e Inteligência Emocional: Capacidade de gerir prioridades conflitantes e manter o foco sob pressão de entregas de curto prazo;   Referência Técnica: Compartilhar conhecimento com a equipe, inspirando excelência jurídica contínua.     Nossos benefícios:     Na Copel você encontra benefícios pensados para apoiar a sua jornada!  Prêmios por Desempenho (PPD) e Participação nos Lucros e Resultados (PLR).   Suporte completo para você e sua família com Auxílio Creche, Licença Maternidade e Paternidade estendida.   Plano de saúde e odontológico completo para você e seus dependentes.   Universidade Corporativa, plataformas de ensino e bolsas de estudo.   Previdência Privada com vantagens exclusivas para quem é Copel. O que buscamos    Formação em Design Gráfico, Artes Visuais, Ilustração ou áreas correlatas — ou portfólio equivalente que comprove a experiência.   Portfólio com foco em ilustração infantil  (item essencial da candidatura).   Domínio de ferramentas de ilustração digital (Pacote Adobe: Adobe Illustrator, indesign e Photoshop; Procreate e afins são bem-vindos).   Conhecimento de preparação de arquivos para impressão.   Sensibilidade estética para o público infantil e versatilidade de estilos.     Será um diferencial    Experiência com ilustração de materiais educacionais e/ou conteúdo infantojuvenil.   Repertório em criação de personagens e identidade visual voltada à infância.   Familiaridade com o fluxo editorial (autor–edição–diagramação–gráfica).   Habilidade com ilustração vetorial.     O que valorizamos no perfil    Criatividade e um olhar afetivo para o universo infantil, aliados a atenção meticulosa aos detalhes.   Organização e disciplina com prazos, com capacidade de conduzir vários projetos ao mesmo tempo.   Espírito colaborativo para dialogar com autores e equipe de produção.   Abertura a feedbacks e comprometimento com a qualidade final da obra.     O que oferecemos    Regime CLT.   Benefícios: Vale Transporte, Vale Refeição, Cartão de Benefícios, Clube Nicky, Totalpass e Telemedicina (Vita).   Horário: segunda a quinta, das 08h às 18h, e sexta, das 08h às 17h. Estamos ansiosos para conhecer o seu trabalho.

performance reporting   Direct and develop designers, specialists, and contractors who execute the program     Requirements   6+ years in lifecycle, retention, CRM, or email and SMS marketing, with title: Crypto Operations Specialist
description:
Confira a vaga para Crypto Operations Specialist em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

About us   Diversas Vagas is a recruitment agency working with companies in fintech, digital assets and online payments. We handle hiring for partners who need people with real technical experience, not just a matching keyword on a CV. This role is open at one of our partner companies, a digital asset business with a distributed team, and we are running the search and the first stages of the process.   About the role    Our partner is looking for a Crypto Operations Specialist to own their daily crypto operations. You will be the person responsible for making sure funds move correctly, safely and on time.   What you will do    Handle incoming and outgoing crypto transfers, conversions between assets, and movement of funds between wallets and exchange accounts.   Work with non-custodial wallets (MetaMask, Trust Wallet, Safe, hardware wallets) across several networks, including Ethereum, Tron, BNB Chain, Solana, Polygon and Arbitrum.   Manage company accounts on major exchanges: deposits and withdrawals, spot conversions, withdrawal limits, address whitelisting, account verification and support tickets.   Choose the right network for each transfer, check fees before sending, and run test transactions before larger amounts go out.   Monitor transactions through block explorers, confirm settlements, and investigate transfers that are delayed, stuck or failed.   Keep accurate records of every operation, reconcile wallet and exchange balances daily, and prepare regular reports for the finance team.   Follow and improve internal security procedures: seed phrase and key handling, hardware wallet use, two-factor authentication, access rights, separation of hot and cold storage.   Review operations for anything unusual, follow AML and KYC procedures, and escalate anything that looks wrong before it becomes a problem.   Work closely with finance, product and support. You will be the person other teams come to with questions about crypto payments, so clear communication matters here.   Help document the process. The company wants procedures written down, not kept in someone's head.    What we are looking for    At least 2 years of hands-on experience in crypto. This is not a role for someone who has only traded on the side.   Real practical experience with non-custodial wallets. You should be comfortable managing keys, setting up multisig, connecting to different networks and recovering access when something goes wrong.   Experience working with centralized exchanges, including withdrawals, deposits, verification and limits.   Solid understanding of crypto asset security and common attack methods: phishing, fake sites, address poisoning, malicious contract approvals.   Strong attention to detail. A wrong network or one wrong character in an address is money gone, and we need someone who checks twice by habit.   Ability to work independently, keep your own records in order and report clearly on what you did.   Working level of English for internal communication and exchange support.   Stable internet connection and your own computer.    Nice to have    Experience with DeFi protocols, bridges and stablecoin flows.   Familiarity with blockchain analytics tools such as Chainalysis or similar.   Previous work in fintech, payments or an exchange.   Confident with spreadsheets and basic reporting.    What the role offers    Salary: $240,000 – $270,000 per year   Paid vacation   Full medical insurance   Remote work with flexible hours, as long as key operations are covered   Equipment and hardware wallets covered by the company   Budget for professional courses and certifications   Small team, direct communication, no long approval chains

title: AI Growth Marketer for Global Running Company
description:
Confira a vaga para AI Growth Marketer for Global Running Company em santa catarina. Veja os detalhes e como se candidatar.

Hi... My name is Lena, and I am the founder of Go! Running Tours.   This is not your usual job post. Instead of writing a fast-paced, bullet-pointed post with the words driven, team player, high performer, etc., I thought I would simply write the good, the bad and the ugly about being our AI Growth Marketer.    I just need one really good applicant!   Let me start with the company. In Go! Running Tours we are working on a global scale, we operate in the intersection between running and travel and you’ll be joining a company that already works with some of the leading brands in the industry. It is equally fun and exciting.    Now for the role. I am looking for someone who can combine outstanding marketing understanding and experience with technical superskills to build a team of agents that improves efficiency and, most importantly, grows revenue.    The ideal candidate will have experience in building marketing AI workflows and agents across research, data analysis, campaign creation and content creation. This is a unique opportunity to take a leap both skills and careerwise and without any red tape or delays. If you have full responsibility and if you have an idea you want to test, you get a quick “go” and then you are off you go to build, test and scale.    This role is 80% execution and 20% strategy. With time, these numbers will switch, but right here and now, we are looking for someone to pull up their sleeves, put on their AI marketing hat and get stuck in.   It’s not all AI. Good old marketing skills are critical for this role. Email marketing, outbound campaigns, case study creation and sponsorships will all be part of your responsibility. You should get a kick out of working with sales and partners to deliver results and grow the business.    I am looking for someone in constant growth mode: always looking for ways to grow the business, develop personally, research new markets and explore new tech, trends and ways of doing things. I am a super user of podcasts, and I want a colleague who is always one day ahead of me and answers “I’m already testing it” when I say, “Hey, I just heard XXX, should we be trying this out?”    Now to the bad. Our budgets are not “to infinity and back”, so you’ll not find yourself swimming in unlimited AI tokens and campaign budgets like Uncle Scrooge in his money bin.   And the ugly. There will also be plenty of unsexy work that we can’t “agent” ourselves out of, at least to begin with. Rest assured, you are not alone. All of us do the unsexy.    You will be working directly with me. I love my job, and every day I am grateful to work in a company with a concept that “makes sense” to me and with colleagues who are skilled, helpful and positive.   I love running, and I have the pleasure of working with runners from all over the world. Together, we cater for the best customer group in the world: runners!   Some people may find me difficult to work with, as I am impatient, focus radically on progress and dislike sloppiness with a passion. Most people, I believe, or at least hope, also find me kind, fun, optimistic, trusting and understanding. Admittedly, I still have very little understanding of sloppiness ;-).   My guess is that if you are good at what you do, talented in marketing and AI, eager to grow and excited to excel in this role, we will end up best buddies!   We work remotely and have only 2 to 3 hours of internal meetings a week. The rest is reserved for deep work and getting things done. We are all on Slack, and there is always time for a call, so you’re never left alone. We’re just on the other side of the world .    The salary will not secure you a Ferrari or a holiday to Mauritius, and money should not be your main motivation. Running, B2B growth, building with AI, bridging cultures and being part of a fun, fast-moving and positive company should.    The contract details are as follows:   USD 2,100 per month  40 hrs per week   Managed via Upwork on a freelance basis    The most important traits to bring to the role are those of a fast mover, a super collaborator and an executor, not the beheading kind, but the “get s*** done” kind. If we don’t execute, we can’t move the needle.    If you feel this role could be for you, please write to me via with a short spiel on why you feel you’re right for the role and why you would like to work at Go! Running Tours.   Please do not send me a generic AI application. I want to hear from the real you, not the “highly motivated individual with a passion for innovative growth strategies” version .    The recruitment process includes logical and personality test as well as two interviews.    Thanks for reading this far,   Lena    Note: We usually take down our job posts within 3 to 4 days as we receive many applicants.
